messages:
Maria Chen: FYI AWS Marketplace flagged a consumption delta for acct ACCT-998 covering 2026-02-24 to 2026-02-28. Their totals are ~12% higher than our internal meter. Can partnerships + finance triage?
Alex Duarte: Which report do they point to? report_id / s3 path?
Maria Chen: Report ID RP-20260228-09. S3 path they gave: s3://aws-marketplace-exports/ACCT-998/2026-02-28/usage.csv. They included per-sku rows (metering_id, sku, usage_quantity, timestamp).
Billing Bot: New marketplace report processed: report_id=RP-20260228-09, file=s3://aws-marketplace-exports/ACCT-998/2026-02-28/usage.csv, checksum=abc123def, processed_at=1752001300.
Liam O'Connor: My guess is SKU->product mapping drift or reserved capacity normalization differences. Quick check SQL:
```
-- check current mapping as of 2026-02-28
select marketplace_sku, product_id, effective_date
from marketplace_sku_map
where effective_date <= '2026-02-28'
order by effective_date desc;
```
Samira Patel: I'll run the reconcile script in dry-run and produce a delta CSV. Command I'm running:
```
./tools/reconcile_marketplace.py --account ACCT-998 --report RP-20260228-09 --dry-run --out /tmp/delta_ACCT-998.csv
```
Maria Chen: Two gotchas to watch for: 1) AWS sometimes sends duplicate events with a sequence_id — dedupe. 2) Our internal meter aggregates to per-minute bills; AWS reports per-second events. Need consistent aggregation.
Alex Duarte: Also watch entitlements/discount normalization. For customers with reserved capacity we show net billable units; marketplace might report gross usage. We need to normalize to billable units before comparing.
Liam O'Connor: Escalation policy reminder: if delta > 5% for a single customer, open AWS billing support and CC finance. Template here: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/marketplace-recon (use the "Line-item request" template).
Samira Patel: Dry-run complete. /tmp/delta_ACCT-998.csv created. Preliminary head: 
```
customer_id,marketplace_usage,internal_usage,delta,reason_code
cust-555,12000,10500,1500,SKU_MAPPING_GAP
cust-662,8000,8050,-50,ROUNDING
cust-701,4300,3000,1300,ENTITLEMENT_NORMALIZATION
```
Billing Bot: Created support ticket AWS-12345 for account ACCT-998 to request line-level events for CPID 555.
Maria Chen: Proposed handling: for positive deltas where AWS > our meter and value > $500, issue provisional credit and open reconciliation task. For mismatches < $50 let month-end net out. Samira, can you produce an "incident-style" delta report with proposed credits and root-cause notes by EOD PST?
Samira Patel: Will do. Noted mapping gap: marketplace_sku 'rdw-embed-lite' wasn't mapped -> fell into 'unknown' so internal usage attributed to a different product. I'll add mapping and re-run (backfill effective_date=2026-02-15).
Alex Duarte: When you update the mapping, add a migration note and notify billing pipeline owners. Also add a unit test to verify unknown-sku alerts.
Liam O'Connor: I'll open a PR to change nightly ETL: aggregate AWS-second-level events to minute buckets to match our meter. PR will include a config toggle for per-customer aggregation window.
Maria Chen: Great. Drop the final CSV to s3://redwood-recon/deltas/ACCT-998/ and tag @eng-finance for review. If AWS hasn't responded by tomorrow 10am PT we'll do the escalation call. :thumbsup:
Alex Duarte: A couple small follow-ups: - include original marketplace row count in the delta CSV header - include checksum of raw file - include mapping version used.
Samira Patel: Done. Uploading now: s3://redwood-recon/deltas/ACCT-998/delta_RP-20260228-09.csv (checksum=def456).
Billing Bot: File uploaded to S3 by Samira Patel: s3://redwood-recon/deltas/ACCT-998/delta_RP-20260228-09.csv (event=upload, ts=1752004500).
Maria Chen: Thanks all. We'll review in the morning if AWS hasn't replied. If AWS provides line-level events that reconcile everything, we'll close and remove provisional credits.
Alex Duarte: I'll monitor AWS support ticket AWS-12345 and paste updates here.
Liam O'Connor: PR for ETL change incoming.
Samira Patel: I'll assemble the final report and put a short executive summary at the top.
Maria Chen: 👍 closing loop for now.
